name: loup-garou

attributes.attribute: a French term for a shape-shifting wolf

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: loup-garou is the French term for a man who changes shape into a wolf. The book sends the reader to the entry for Shape-shifting. There the being with the changing form is told of at length.
